tips.text: Radshare Radiant relics with four players on the same relic; never open a Radiant vaulted relic in a public squad.
Find vaulted radshares through radshare.xyz or the Vaulted Relic Community Discord; recruiting chat is slow for old relics.
Do not plan around Baro; he may not bring Neo O1 or Axi V8 for a long time.
Refine Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant and leave Blueprint relics Intact; Radiant lowers Common odds to 16.67%.
Radshare rather than stagger a relic you can rebuy; staggering saves traces but takes about four times as long.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; you keep the item and they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
Buy extra relics for Volt Prime Neuroptics; it is the Rare in every one that carries it.
Bank Aya before his rotation opens; it never expires.
Expect an open-ended wait: Varzia gives no schedule and Baro may never bring the relics.
Collect Aya during bounties you were running anyway; players regret grinding it as a dedicated activity.
